name: exact_simple
spec: Rule 2a: an option equal to the preference.

name: case_insensitive_exact
spec: Comparison is case-insensitive.

name: repeated_spaces_and_trailing_period
spec: Comparison ignores repeated spaces and a trailing period.

name: preference_order_substring_beats_later_exact
spec: The FIRST preference that matches any option decides; a later preference may never win while an earlier one matches something.

name: exact_beats_earlier_substring
spec: For one preference, try in this order: a. an option equal to the preference; b. an option that contains the preference as a substring.

name: substring_forward
spec: b. an option that contains the preference as a substring.

name: reverse_containment_multiword
spec: also an option whose own text is contained in the preference, but ONLY when that option has at least two words after removing the words and/of/the/a/an/or/in/for.

name: reverse_containment_one_word_rejected
spec: a one-word option such as "Science", "Data" or "Analytics" never matches this way.

name: word_containment_computer_science
spec: c. an option that contains every word of the preference (ignoring and/of/the/a/an/or/in/for).

name: word_containment_with_stop_words
spec: c. an option that contains every word of the preference (ignoring and/of/the/a/an/or/in/for).

name: earlier_pref_c_beats_later_exact
spec: The FIRST preference that matches any option decides; a later preference may never win while an earlier one matches something.

name: b_before_c_even_if_c_option_earlier
spec: For one preference, try in this order: a. an option equal to the preference; b. an option that contains the preference as a substring; c. an option that contains every word of the preference.

name: c_first_in_list_order
spec: Within one step, the first option in list order wins.

name: b_first_in_list_order
spec: Within one step, the first option in list order wins.

name: short_pref_only_exact_none
spec: Preferences shorter than 4 characters only use step a.

name: short_pref_exact
spec: Preferences shorter than 4 characters only use step a.

name: ignore_other_preference
spec: The preference "Other" (and empty strings) are ignored.

name: ignore_empty_and_other
spec: The preference "Other" (and empty strings) are ignored.

name: no_match_none
spec: Nothing matches → None.

name: earlier_pref_no_match_later_matches
spec: Go through the preferences in order.

name: exact_after_trailing_period_in_option
spec: Comparison ignores repeated spaces and a trailing period.

name: length_four_uses_substring
spec: Preferences shorter than 4 characters only use step a.

name: information_systems_word_containment
spec: c. an option that contains every word of the preference (ignoring and/of/the/a/an/or/in/for).

name: pref_repeated_spaces_and_period
spec: Comparison is case-insensitive and ignores repeated spaces and a trailing period.
